$comment: #EXP-1786 (owner-approved 2026-11-12, AMENDS the WIDE layout below): THE PLAN YIELDS TO ITS PANE. Wide (web md+, the IDE) measures the plan body's OWN width (beside the chat it is the session screen's pane, ~640 px at a 1440 px window), never the window: `planPaneLayout(width)` (`paneCases`) = {outline, rail}: width ≥ `layout.outlineWidth` + `layout.railWidth` + `layout.documentMinWidth` = the three columns (outline · document · rail); else width ≥ `layout.railWidth` + `layout.documentMinWidth` = the document + the rail, NO outline column (no toggle: the sections stay in the document); else the document alone, the questions = THE floating panel (`panel`, the phone form, unchanged), no outline column. The document never draws narrower than `layout.documentMinWidth` while the pane allows it. Phones keep their form (`rail` false; the outline in THE Drawer). #FEED-191 (owner 2026-11-05, Danny on the plan tab; AMENDS everything below that disagrees): (1) THE TAB'S GLYPH = `planTabGlyph(decision)` (`tabGlyphCases`): an APPROVED plan's chip leads with THE check (`ui-check`) in emerald, the plan row's approved check, replacing the plan glyph; anything else keeps `coding-plan` in the chip's text colour (the waiting dot unchanged). (2) A DECIDED PLAN LEAVES THE STRIP (else the strip grows forever): `planTabTarget(plans, kept)` (`tabCases`) = the newest WAITING plan, else `kept` while it is an approved or rejected plan of the chat, else none (no chip). `kept` = the plan the tab last showed during THIS VISIT of the chat: host view state, set to the tab's target whenever it is non-null and to a plan whose row was pressed, CLEARED when the person leaves the chat (unmount / navigation away; switching tabs inside the chat keeps it). So a plan decided while the person is in the chat keeps its chip, now with its check, until they leave; coming back, a decided plan has no chip; every plan stays reachable from its row in the Conversation, a press opening the tab on it (that sets `kept`). An agent chat's strip (chats.json `agentChat.planTabs`) follows: `holdsPlan` = `planTabTarget(plans, kept)` is non-null. (3) THE QUESTIONS: WIDE (web md+, the IDE) = THE RAIL again, as before #EXP-1662's floating panel: `layout.railWidth` wide on the RIGHT of the body, full height beside the document (outline · document · rail), the sidebar background, a hairline on its left, sticky (it never scrolls with the document), padding `panel.padding`; inside, top to bottom: the `copy.questions` heading (with the step label trailing when there is more than one question), the stepper's one question scrolling inside the rail, Back / Next, and the decision pinned to its foot; a plan without questions = the decision alone; decided or superseded = the closed card. The document's scroll no longer pads for a panel. PHONE (iOS, Android, web-mobile) = the floating panel (`panel`) UNCHANGED: a sheet would hide the document the person decides on. #FEED-191 (owner 2026-11-04: 'when a plan gets approved in the plan detail page then we need to navigate to the chat such that we can see the agent work further'; AMENDS the below): any DECISION made on the Plan tab (approve, or No, keep planning) returns to the chat's Conversation tab ×4; a decision made from the Conversation stays put. A Needs-you row is needs-you.json's. #EXP-1662 (owner 2026-11-03, AMENDS everything below that disagrees): THE PLAN IS A TAB ×4. No plan is drawn inline any more and there is no separate page chrome. CONVERSATION: a plan card = ONE row (THE session card's box, `layout.rowHeight`): the `coding-plan` glyph (amber while waiting, emerald check when approved, muted otherwise), `planRowLabel(plan)` (`rowLabelCases`, one line truncated), the status word (waiting = `copy.needsYou` in the needs-you tone, else ask-dock `planDecisionLabel`), flex, `ui-chevron-right`; a press opens the plan tab on THAT plan. A session row whose session waits on a plan expands to this same row. A superseded or dismissed plan keeps its one closed line. THE STRIP (session-chat.json `tabs`): a chat holding a plan draws ONE strip chip right after Conversation, active while shown, reading `Plan: title` (`planRowLabel`, capped at `layout.tabMaxWidth`, md+ and the IDE) or `copy.title` (phones, one page of the pager after Conversation), with the 6 px needs-you dot while its plan waits. It replaces that plan's waiting chip (waiting-cards.json chips keep the questions only). An AGENT'S CHAT (chats.json AGENT CHAT, owner 2026-11-04) has no strip of its own: holding a plan gives it THE strip with exactly Conversation and this chip (`agentChat.planTabs`), and the tab stays open until the person switches. `planTabTarget(plans)` (`tabCases`: the chat's plan cards, oldest first) = the newest waiting one, else the newest approved or rejected one, else none; an older plan shows only when its row was pressed (`?tab=plan&plan=<id>`). THE BODY: selecting the tab replaces ONLY the content under the header + strip, on the chat's own ground (the content card, as session and issue detail: no fill of its own), no composer, and NO page header: no breadcrumb, no counts line, no Open chat, no close, no `Open plan`. WIDE = the Outline column (unchanged) + the document. PHONE = the document alone, the outline toggle `ui-menu` a ghost button at the document's top right, opening THE Drawer. TITLE: `planBlocks` lifts a leading `# ` line into a `title` block (plain text as for section titles): `layout.titleSize` at weight 600; every other `# ` stays in the prose. THE QUESTIONS float over the foot of the document, replacing the rail and the Dock card: a panel centred on the document column, `panel.maxWidth` wide (phones: the width less `panel.gap` each side), `panel.gap` above the bottom edge, the menu surface fill + hairline + `panel.radius`, `panel.padding`; it hugs its content up to `panel.maxHeightFraction` of the body and scrolls inside past that, the footer pinned; the document's scroll pads by the panel's height + 2 × `panel.gap`. Inside: plan-card `stepper`: the step label top right (more than one question), one question at a time, Back / Next bottom right, the decision on the last step, the feedback field after the reject pick; a plan without questions = the decision alone; decided or superseded = the closed card. WAYS IN: the row, the chip, an inbox row or push, a Needs-you row; the deep link `route` redirects to the chat's tab. #EXP-1493 THE PLAN PAGE ×4 (owner 2026-10-31, session b836a4a9): the EXPANDED FORM of THE plan card (plan-card.json), one system, never a second plan UI. Web packages/ui plan-page.tsx + the route `route` (apps/web routes/t/$teamSlug/sessions/$sessionId.plan.$messageId.tsx), desktop crates/ui plan_page.rs (a tab of the session pane), iOS ExpUI PlanPage.swift + Android ui/plan/PlanPage.kt (a pushed page); models: desktop domain::plan_page, iOS ExpCore PlanPage.swift, Android domain/PlanPage.kt replay EVERY *Cases array comparing the WHOLE expected value. MODEL (pure, src/plan-page.ts): `planBlocks(markdown)` (`blockCases`) splits the card's `plan` GFM in order: every `## ` line outside a code fence = a `section` block {id, title} (title = the heading's plain text: links to their text, ** __ ` dropped; id = `sectionSlug`: lowercase, every run of anything but a-z0-9 = `-`, edges trimmed, empty = `section`; a repeat gets `-2`, `-3`…); a RUN of two or more picture-only lines (`![alt](src)` alone on its line, blank lines between them allowed) = ONE `pictures` block {pictures: [{alt, src}]}; a lone picture stays in the prose; a pending `upload:` picture renders NOTHING (dropped, also inline); the rest = `markdown` blocks (blank edge lines trimmed, empty ones dropped). `planOutline(markdown)` (`outlineCases`) = one row per section {id, title, pictures} (pictures = what the blocks after it show until the next section; fenced code shows none; the prose before the first section is in no row). `planCounts(card)` (`countCases`) = {sections: the outline's length, pictures: the card's RESOLVED pictures (attachmentId set), questions: the card's questions}; `planCountsLine(counts)` (`countsLineCases`) = the non-zero parts in that order, `copy.counts` singular for 1, ` · ` between; all zero = ``. `planPageFor(sessionId, messages)` (`targetCases`) = the NEWEST (createdAt, then id) plan card the session posted ITSELF (author_session_id = session_id), no engine `questionId`, `decision` null; else null. `mosaicTiles(count)` (`mosaicCases`) = THE wide picture group (eUI `Mosaic`): 1 = one large tile, 2 = two `half` tiles side by side, 3+ = the first `large` on the left (both rows) and the next two `small` stacked on the right, the last carrying `more` = count − 3 ("+N" over it, scrim black 0.55); geometry `mosaic`: `gap` between tiles, the large tile `largeFraction` of the width, the whole group `aspect` w/h, `radius` + the glass-stroke hairline, pictures cover. LAYOUT. WIDE (web md+, the IDE) = three columns under ONE header row (`layout.headerHeight`, a hairline under it): the header = the back chevron, the chat's name muted, `/`, `copy.title` semibold, (waiting = a 6 px needs-you dot, the sidebar's `needsYou` tone, `semantic.yellow`; no word) then flex, the counts line muted (`planCountsLine`), `copy.openChat` (ghost), the close glyph. LEFT = THE OUTLINE (eUI `Outline`, `layout.outlineWidth`, a hairline on its right): the `copy.outline` caption (2xs uppercase muted) then one row per section (`layout.outlineRowHeight`, the title one line truncated, a muted `· n` when it has pictures), the ACTIVE row (scroll-spy: the last section whose heading passed the top of the column; none yet = no active row) = the accent background + a `layout.outlineActiveBar` px foreground bar on its leading edge; a press scrolls the document to that section; then a separator and the QUESTIONS row (`copy.questions`, trailing `· n`) that scrolls nothing (the rail already shows them); no section and no question = no outline column. CENTRE = THE DOCUMENT, one scroll, a column `layout.columnMaxWidth` wide centred, `layout.columnPadding` (wide/phone) above and on the sides, `layout.blockGap` between blocks: `markdown` = THE chat markdown renderer at the body size (plan-card.json `card` headingScale etc.), `section` = an h2 (THE markdown h2) carrying the anchor, `pictures` = wide: THE Mosaic; phone: THE eUI Carousel (one slide per picture at its aspect, the "i / n" counter top-left, dots under it, swipe). A press on ANY picture (mosaic tile, carousel slide, an inline picture) opens THE lightbox (`ImagePreviewDialog` + guide-viewer `‹ i / n ›`) over EVERY picture of the plan in document order. RIGHT = THE RAIL (`layout.railWidth`, the sidebar background, a hairline on its left, STICKY: it never scrolls with the document): the `copy.questions` heading + plan-card.json `stepper` (its step label, the segments, one question at a time, Back / Next) and pinned to its foot the decision (ask-dock `planOptions`: No, keep planning / Yes ▾, the answer-issue line over it, the feedback field after the reject pick); a plan without questions = the decision alone; answered or superseded = the CLOSED card (picks, `planDecisionLabel`, the feedback line), no decision row. PHONE (iOS, Android, web-mobile) = the SAME document in one scroll under a page header (the back chevron, `copy.title`, the outline toggle glyph `ui-menu` when the outline has a row): the kind badge + the h1 title + the counts line lead the column; the outline opens in THE eUI Drawer (bottom sheet, the same rows); the bottom = THE Dock with ONE DockCard, dock.json's plan card UNCHANGED (`dockRows` of the plan: `Plan ready`, the asking session's name, `n questions`, the plan's title) floating over the document's foot; a tap opens THE Dock sheet QUESTIONS-ONLY (plan-card `stepper` without its plan page: the document is the page; fewer than `stepper.minQuestions` = every question on one page) with THE decision; NO composer on this page ('No, keep planning' carries the feedback); decided = the same sheet shows the closed card. A decision on the page goes through THE card-answer path (`sessions.answer`) and the page stays open, closed. WAYS IN ×4 (all open THIS page for that message): the chat's plan card header action (`copy.openPlan`, a ghost button with `ui-fullscreen`); the Dock sheet header glyph `ui-fullscreen` (`copy.openFull`); an inbox row / push whose `inboxRowTarget` is a session with `planPageFor` ≠ null; the Needs-you row (chat-row-action.json) of a plan: `copy.openPlan` next to its open-chat link. Deep link: the web path `planPagePath(teamSlug, sessionId, messageId)`; a message that is not a plan card = the session.

# Plan: editor-first app creation

A new app opens straight in the editor; every app gets an MCP endpoint.

## Current state
- Creating an app starts from a form.
- The editor opens only after the first save.

The editor opens on an empty canvas with the chat docked.

![web editor preview](/api/attachments/sg-2)
![web editor data](/api/attachments/sg-3)
![web editor versions](/api/attachments/sg-4)

Each team's apps answer at one MCP endpoint, scoped by a team token.

## Phased issues
1. The contract
2. The editor
3. The MCP endpoint

Keep the floating chat layout in the editor?

the plan decided during this visit keeps its chip
an older plan opened from its row keeps the chip
a waiting plan wins over the kept one
a kept plan that was superseded: no chip
a kept id no longer in the chat: no chip
